paper_title: Realizing an Unprecedented Fill Factor of 82.2% in Ternary Organic Solar Cells via Co-Crystallization of Non-Fullerene Acceptors
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2023 - Chen - Realizing an Unprecedented Fill Factor of 82 2  in Ternary Organic Solar Cells via/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2023 - Chen - Realizing an Unprecedented Fill Factor of 82 2  in Ternary Organic Solar Cells via.md

knowledge_points.content: Three thiophene-terminated non-fullerene acceptors (NFAs) named BTP-ThMe, BTP-ThCl, and BTP-ThMeCl were synthesized by varying methyl and chlorine substitutions on the 2-(6-oxo-5,6-dihydro-4H-cyclopenta[c]thiophen-4-ylidene)malononitrile (CPTCN) end-groups.
knowledge_points.evidence: In this study, three thiophene terminated non-fullerene acceptors (NFAs) with methyl or chlorine substitutions on their end-groups are designed and synthesized... namely BTP-ThMe, BTP-ThCl, and BTP-ThMeCl.

knowledge_points.content: The ternary organic solar cell based on PM6:L8-BO:BTP-ThMeCl achieved a record fill factor (FF) of 82.2% and a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 19.1%.
knowledge_points.evidence: ...consequently realizing a maximum power conversion efficiency of 19.1% with a superior FF of 82.2%, which is the highest FF reported so far for OSCs.

knowledge_points.content: Chlorine substitution in the CPTCN group plays a dominant role in narrowing the optical bandgap to approximately 1.39 eV and lowering the HOMO/LUMO levels to around -5.70/-3.80 eV, compared to methyl substitution.
knowledge_points.evidence: When chlorine was introduced into the CPTcN group either with or without the presence of methyl, all films show a narrowed bandgap of ≈ 1.39 eV with almost the same LUMO/HOMO values of around -3.80/-5.70 eV, suggesting that the chlorine substitution plays a determining role in their bandgap and energy levels.

knowledge_points.content: BTP-ThMeCl exhibits a compact 3D honeycomb charge transport network due to the coexistence of 'Z' shaped D-D, 'S' shaped A-A, and 'F' shaped A-D molecular dimers, which is analogous to the packing of the host acceptor L8-BO.
knowledge_points.evidence: While BTP-ThMe and BTP-ThCl have limited forms of dimer, versatile molecular dimers, including 'Z' shaped D-D, 'S' shaped A-A, and 'F' shaped A-D packings exist in BTP-ThMeCl, which lead to the formation of compact 3D honey-comb network and this is analogous to the host acceptor L8-BO.

knowledge_points.content: The ternary solar cells utilize a cascade energetic structure where the third component NFAs (BTP-ThMe, BTP-ThCl, or BTP-ThMeCl) are positioned between the energy levels of the PM6 donor and L8-BO host acceptor, facilitating charge transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: It is clear that all NFAs show a cascade energetic structure within the host blend, which might be beneficial for facilitating charge transport in the ternary blends.

knowledge_points.content: Grazing-incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS) analysis shows that BTP-ThMeCl enhances the (021) and (11-1) diffraction peaks of L8-BO in ternary films, indicating synergetic co-crystallization.
knowledge_points.evidence: BTP-ThMeCl greatly elevates the diffraction intensity of the (021) and (11-1) peaks... the synergetic molecular packing of BTP-ThMeCl may trigger the co-crystallization of BTP-ThMeCl and L8-BO at the molecular level.

knowledge_points.content: Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) measurements confirm that BTP-ThMeCl and L8-BO form co-crystals at the molecular level because the measured melting temperatures (Tm) match the calculated values across all blending ratios.
knowledge_points.evidence: the measured and calculated values in the BTP-ThMeCl:L8-BO blends agree well in all ratios without any deviation. This suggests that... BTP-ThMeCl and L8-BO can form co-crystals at the molecular level.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized ternary organic solar cell was fabricated by incorporating 20 wt% of the third component NFA into the PM6:L8-BO host binary blend.
knowledge_points.evidence: When 20 wt.% of BTP-ThMe, BTP-ThCl, and BTP-ThMeCl were added into the PM6:L8-BO blends respectively to fabricate ternary OSCs...

knowledge_points.content: GISAXS fitting using Debye-Anderson-Brumberger and Flexible Cylinder models reveals that adding BTP-ThMeCl to the PM6:L8-BO blend increases the fibril length to 60.4 nm and reduces the diameter to 3.3 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: the addition of those three thiophene terminated NFAs all stimulated prolonged fibril length, to... 60.4 nm in... BTP-ThMeCl based ternary films. The diameters... reduced to 3.3 nm in PM6:L8-BO:BTP-ThMeCl film.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations indicate that BTP-ThMeCl possesses a larger dihedral angle (5.2°/9.2°) compared to BTP-ThMe and BTP-ThCl due to increased steric hindrance from dual substitution, which may assist in 3D molecular packing.
knowledge_points.evidence: these values increased to 5.2°/9.2° in the dual-substituted BTP-ThMeCl due to the increased steric hindrance between the substituents and cyano-group... the larger dihedral angles of BTP-ThMeCl might also be helpful for molecular packings in three dimensions.

knowledge_points.content: Thiophene-terminated NFAs contribute to low non-radiative voltage loss (approximately 0.2 V) in binary and ternary organic solar cells, which benefits overall device performance.
knowledge_points.evidence: These binary OSCs all obtained promising Voc with extremally low non-radiative voltage loss (Vloss non-rad) of ≈ 0.2 V... confirming the superiority of the thiophene terminated NFAs for suppressing the non-radiative voltage loss.
